# Environment names

Every variable name snug has a type for, and the verbs a profile may use on it.
A name not listed here takes `set` and `inherit`, or the verbs of the type a profile declares for it
in `environ.types`. See [Environment](../environment.md#declaring-a-type).

**path**: every element must be granted by the profile that writes it.
**empty element**: what the program reading the variable does with one.

| name | kind | separator | empty element | path | verbs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `BASH_ENV` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `BROWSER` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `CARGO_HOME` | scalar |  |  | yes | `set` `inherit` |
| `CDPATH` | list | `:` | current directory | yes | none |
| `CLASSPATH` | list | `:` or `;` |  | yes | `merge` `prepend` `sanitise` |
| `DOCKER_CONFIG` | scalar |  |  | yes | `set` `inherit` |
| `EDITOR` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `ENV` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `GOFLAGS` | list | space |  |  | none |
| `GOPATH` | list | `:` |  | yes | `merge` `prepend` `sanitise` |
| `INFOPATH` | list | `:` | system location | yes | `merge` `prepend` `sanitise` |
| `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` | list | `:` or `;` | current directory | yes | none |
| `LD_PRELOAD` | list | `:` or space |  | yes | none |
| `LESSOPEN` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `MANPATH` | list | `:` | inserts the default | yes | `merge` `prepend` |
| `NODE_PATH` | list | `:` | ignored | yes | `merge` `prepend` `sanitise` |
| `NO_COLOR` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG` | scalar |  |  | yes | `set` `inherit` |
| `PAGER` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `PATH` | list | `:` | current directory | yes | `merge` `prepend` `sanitise` |
| `PERL5LIB` | list | `:` | ignored | yes | `merge` `prepend` `sanitise` |
| `PIP_CONFIG_FILE` | scalar |  |  | yes | `set` `inherit` |
| `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` | list | `:` | ignored | yes | `merge` `prepend` `sanitise` |
| `PYTHONBREAKPOINT` | scalar |  |  |  | `set` `inherit` |
| `PYTHONPATH` | list | `:` | current directory | yes | `merge` `prepend` |

| `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` | scalar |  |  | yes | `set` `inherit` |

| `XDG_DATA_HOME` | scalar |  |  | yes | `set` `inherit` |

## Names snug writes

No profile may `set`, `inherit` or declare these, in any run, whether or not snug writes
the name in that run. `PATH` is a list and still takes `merge` and `prepend`.

| snug writes it | names |
|---|---|
| every run | `HOME` `LOGNAME` `PATH` `PS1` `SHELL` `SNUG` `SNUG_PROFILES` `SNUG_TARGET` `TMPDIR` `USER` |
| when the host has a value | `LANG` `TERM` `TZ` |

## Names snug writes when a feature is on

In a selection that turns the feature on, a profile line on one of these names is refused.
The refusal names that profile, and the profile and key that turned the feature on. With the
feature off, a profile may write them. No profile may declare them in `environ.types`, and no
built-in profile writes them. **also claimed** names are ones snug does not write, but the tool
reads them in place of what snug wrote.

| feature on when | snug writes | also claimed |
|---|---|---|
| `podman` is `"socket"` or `"build"` | `CONTAINER_HOST` `DOCKER_BUILDKIT` `DOCKER_HOST` | `CONTAINER_CONNECTION` |
| `identity.ssh.agent` is `"proxy"` | `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` |  |
| `identity.gh.user` is set | `GH_CONFIG_DIR` `GH_HOST` | `GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN` `GH_TOKEN` `GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN` `GITHUB_TOKEN` |
| an `identity.ssh` or `identity.git` block | `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` |  |
| `listen_names` is set | `LISTEN_FDNAMES` `LISTEN_FDS` `LISTEN_PID` |  |
| `login` includes `"claude"` | `BROWSER` |  |
